result.instructions: Tools for NubeFact, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Issue a boleta to customer DNI 12345678 for two items at S/ 50 each."; "Did SUNAT accept factura F001-123? Show me the PDF link."; "Void boleta B001-45 because of a system error.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NubeFact data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nubefact_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nubefact_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nubefact_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nubefact_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nubefact_issue_document
tools.title: Issue a factura, boleta or note
tools.description: Issue an electronic factura (tipo 1), boleta (tipo 2), credit note (tipo 3) or debit note (tipo 4) through NubeFact, which sends it to SUNAT. Totals are computed from the lines (IGV 18% on gravado lines). This creates a legal document: it cannot be edited or deleted. Void a wrong one with nubefact_void_document. Check the series and number first with nubefact_get_document. Operation: generar_comprobante.

tipo_de_comprobante.description: 1 = factura, 2 = boleta, 3 = nota de crédito, 4 = nota de débito.

serie.description: Series, 4 characters. Starts with F for facturas, B for boletas (notes take the series of their document).

tipo_de_cambio.description: Exchange rate to soles (3 decimals). Required when moneda is not 1.

cliente_tipo_de_documento.description: 6 = RUC, 1 = DNI, - = varios (sales under S/700), 4 = carnet de extranjería, 7 = pasaporte, A = cédula diplomática, B = documento de identidad del país de residencia, 0 = no domiciliado (exportación), G = salvoconducto.

cliente_email.description: Customer email. NubeFact emails the document only when enviar_automaticamente_al_cliente is true.

enviar_automaticamente_al_cliente.description: Email the document to the customer.

enviar_automaticamente_a_la_sunat.description: Send the document to SUNAT now (default true).

codigo.description: Your internal product or service code (optional).

valor_unitario.description: Unit value WITHOUT IGV. The tool adds the IGV (18%).

items.description: Document lines. Totals are computed from these lines.

documento_que_se_modifica.description: The document a note changes. Required for notes (tipo 3 and 4).

serie.description: Series, 4 characters. Starts with F for facturas, B for boletas (notes take the series of their document).

motivo_de_nota.description: Note reason code. Credit notes 1-13 (1 = anulación de la operación, 6 = devolución total). Debit notes 1-5 (1 = intereses por mora, 3 = penalidades). Required for notes.

tools.name: nubefact_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Read one issued factura, boleta or note: its PDF, XML and CDR links, whether SUNAT accepted it, and whether it is voided. Operation: consultar_comprobante.

tipo_de_comprobante.description: 1 = factura, 2 = boleta, 3 = nota de crédito, 4 = nota de débito.

serie.description: Series, 4 characters. Starts with F for facturas, B for boletas (notes take the series of their document).

tools.name: nubefact_void_document
tools.title: Void a document
tools.description: Void (anular) an issued factura, boleta or note. NubeFact sends a voiding communication to SUNAT. The voiding is final: check it later with nubefact_get_void_status. Operation: generar_anulacion.

tipo_de_comprobante.description: 1 = factura, 2 = boleta, 3 = nota de crédito, 4 = nota de débito.

serie.description: Series, 4 characters. Starts with F for facturas, B for boletas (notes take the series of their document).

motivo.description: Reason for the voiding, for example "ERROR DEL SISTEMA".

tools.description: Read the voiding (anulación) of a factura, boleta or note: the SUNAT ticket, whether SUNAT accepted it, and the PDF, XML and CDR links. Operation: consultar_anulacion.
